Class CharacterCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.Card.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.Card.CharacterCard.CharacterCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
ItaEngRectangable, Rectangable, Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Artist, Builder, Gatherer, Hunter, Inventor, Shaman
public abstract class CharacterCard extends Card implements Serializable
Represents an abstract base class for all Character Cards in the game.

Character cards represent the members of a player's tribe (e.g., Artists, Builders, Hunters). Unlike BuildingCards, character cards generally do not have an inherent food cost to be acquired and are automatically placed in the player's databank upon drawing, expanding their tribe's capabilities or providing multipliers for events.

  • Method Details

    • canGet

      public boolean canGet(Player player)
      Indicates whether a player can acquire this card.

      For basic CharacterCards, this method always returns true. Unlike buildings that require a specific amount of food to be purchased, characters can always be picked up by a player using a standard draw action.

      Specified by:
      canGet in class Card
      Parameters:
      player - the Player attempting to acquire the card
      Returns:
      always true

    • isLowerLineOnSetup

      public boolean isLowerLineOnSetup()
      Determines if this card can be placed on the lower line during the game setup.

      Character cards are valid candidates for the lower line during the initial setup phase of the board.

      isLowerLineOnSetup in class Card
